# Semantic layer index

Pick the entities, metrics and terms a question needs, then run
`mautoontology context --entities a,b --metrics m` for joins, filters and warnings.
Status legend: approved = reviewed, proposed = generated and unreviewed, draft = incomplete.

## Domain: sales

### Entities

- `account` (dimension, approved) - `accounts`, grain: account_id
  - joins to: customer (one to one)
- `account_balance` (snapshot, approved, snapshot) - `account_balances`, grain: account_id, snapshot_date - Daily end-of-day balance per account (periodic snapshot).
  - joins to: account (many to one)
- `address` (dimension, approved) - `addresses`, grain: address_id
  - joins to: customer (many to one)
- `category` (dimension, approved) - `categories`, grain: category_id
  - joins to: category as parent (many to one), product (many to many)
- `customer` (dimension, approved, default filters) - `customers`, grain: customer_id - One row per customer. Soft-deleted customers are GDPR erasures.
- `customer_history` (history, approved, scd2, default filters) - `customer_history`, grain: customer_sk
  - joins to: customer (many to one)
- `employee` (dimension, approved) - `employees`, grain: employee_id
  - joins to: employee as manager (many to one)
- `order` (fact, approved, default filters) - `orders`, grain: order_id - One row per web-shop order. Cancelled and returned orders are kept; soft-deleted rows are test data.
  - joins to: address as billing (many to one), customer (many to one), address as shipping (many to one)
- `order_item` (fact, approved) - `order_items`, grain: order_id, line_no - One row per order line (product, quantity, unit price at order time).
  - joins to: order (many to one), product (many to one)
- `product` (dimension, approved) - `products`, grain: product_id
- `product_category` (bridge, approved) - `product_categories`, grain: product_id, category_id
  - joins to: category (many to one), product (many to one)
- `promo` (dimension, proposed) - `promos`, grain: promo_id
- `shipment` (dimension, approved) - `shipments`, grain: shipment_id
  - joins to: order (one to one)

### Metrics

- `average_order_value` (ratio, approved) - Net revenue per non-cancelled order. - aka: aov, basket size
- `gross_revenue` (simple, approved) - Value of all non-cancelled orders, including later returns. - aka: gross sales, gmv
  - note: Includes returned orders. Use net_revenue when someone just says revenue.
- `net_revenue` (simple, approved) - Value of orders that were neither cancelled nor returned. - aka: revenue, sales, net sales, turnover
  - note: The default meaning of 'revenue'. Amounts are in the order currency: group by currency or convert.
- `order_count` (simple, approved) - Number of non-cancelled orders. - aka: number of orders, order volume
- `units_sold` (simple, approved) - Quantity of products on order lines. - aka: items sold, quantity sold

## Glossary

- **basket_size**: Average order value (net revenue per order). -> metric:average_order_value
- **nordic_customer**: A customer in Denmark or Sweden. -> segment:customer.nordic
- **revenue**: Money from orders. Means net revenue unless the user explicitly says gross. -> metric:net_revenue, metric:gross_revenue
  - note: Default to net_revenue and say that returns are excluded.

## Verified queries

- `net_revenue_by_month_and_currency`: What was net revenue per month, by currency?
- `orders_per_country`: How many orders did customers in each country place?
- `units_per_order_with_amount`: For each order, how many units and what amount?
